title: Quietly Rich Mexican Beef Wrap
description: A fatty and silky Mexican dish featuring ghee and ssam-wrap, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and friendly to those with egg allergies.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the ghee to the skillet and let it melt.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the beef mixture until it is fully browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the beef mixture onto the center of each wrap and serving immediately.
